title: Don't be so sure!
evenTitle: He may be ... He may have been ... I'm not sure.
evenTitleZh: 他可能是……他可能已经……我不敢肯定。

dialogue.speaker: Martin
dialogue.en: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
dialogue.zh: 加里，今年你们打算去哪里度假？

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: We may go abroad. I'm not sure.
dialogue.zh: 我们可能到国外去，但我不敢肯定。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: My wife wants to go to Egypt.

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: I'd like to go there, too.

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: We can't make up our minds.

dialogue.speaker: Martin
dialogue.en: Will you travel by sea or by air?
dialogue.zh: 你们乘船去，还是乘飞机去？

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
dialogue.zh: 可能是便宜些，但花的时间长。

dialogue.speaker: Martin
dialogue.zh: 我肯定你们一定会玩得很痛快。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.zh: 我们可能哪里也去不成。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: My wife always worries too much.
dialogue.zh: 我妻子总是担心这担心那的。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: Who's going to look after the dog?

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: Who's going to look after the house?

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: Who's going to look after the garden?

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: We have this problem every year.
dialogue.zh: 我们每年都碰到这类问题。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
dialogue.zh: 末了，我们呆在家里来照看一切。
